title: FinCUABuild: Can Agents Build Reliable Benchmarks for Dynamic Financial Computer Use?
abstract: arXiv:2609.07603v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial scenarios are diverse and complex, spanning varying data conditions, tool configurations, and workflows. Yet existing CUA, Computer-Using Agent, evaluation tasks remain largely manually constructed, limiting scalable coverage of real-world financial scenarios. Then, can agents autonomously construct diverse CUA evaluation tasks for financial scenarios? Evaluating this capability poses three key challenges: scenario coverage of construction requests, fair comparison across construction methods, and reliable assessment of generated task quality. To solve these, we introduce FinCUABuildBench, a benchmark for evaluating financial CUA task construction, featuring: (i) 576 construction requests covering 24 financial workflows and three types of runtime variation; (ii) standardized input, budget, and output specifications; and (iii) a task qualification mechanism based on execution tests and quality checks. translated_title: FinCUABuild：智能体能否为动态金融计算机使用构建可靠基准？
translated_abstract: 金融场景多样且复杂，涵盖不同的数据条件、工具配置和工作流程。然而，现有的CUA（计算机使用智能体）评估任务在很大程度上仍是人工构建的，这限制了对真实金融场景的可扩展覆盖。那么，智能体能否自主构建多样化的金融场景CUA评估任务？评估这一能力面临三大关键挑战：构建请求的场景覆盖、不同构建方法之间的公平比较，以及生成任务质量的可靠评估。为解决这些问题，我们提出了FinCUABuildBench，这是一个用于评估金融CUA任务构建能力的基准，其特点包括：(i) 576个构建请求，覆盖24种金融工作流程和三类运行时变化；(ii) 标准化的输入、预算和输出规范；(iii) 基于执行测试和质量检查的任务资格认证机制。我们进一步引入了FinCUA（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出FinCUABuildBench基准，通过576个覆盖24种金融工作流的构建请求、标准化的输入输出规范以及基于执行测试的任务资格认证机制，系统评估智能体自主构建可靠金融场景CUA评估任务的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FinCUABuildBench, a benchmark featuring 576 construction requests across 24 financial workflows, standardized input/budget/output specifications, and an execution-test-based task qualification mechanism to evaluate whether agents can autonomously build reliable CUA evaluation tasks for financial scenarios.
